projects.title: Environmental Forecasting Capstone
bullets: Implemented a seasonal baseline for public temperature sensor forecasting as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone team.
Plotted forecast residuals and identified missing observations in public temperature sensor time series using Python and pandas.

projects.title: Air Quality Forecasting Course Project
bullets: Aligned public air-quality sensor time series as an assigned contribution to a supervised graduate course team project.
Plotted forecast residuals for public air-quality sensor series using Python within the course project's environmental forecasting scope.

research.title: Public Review Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public product-review text records as a student research assistant working under faculty supervision.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier using Python and scikit-learn for supervised research on classifying short public text documents.

research.title: River Level Time Series Forecasting
bullets: Implemented a seasonal baseline for forecasting public river-level measurement series as part of supervised faculty research.
Identified missing observations in public river-level time series using Python and pandas within the supervised forecasting work.
